title: 第8章 连夜逃命第9章 逃亡之路
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
杨妈一边向里面走去，一边喊道“小姐！小姐！我是杨妈！你在哪个房间了呀？”东厢房传来一个女人的声音回答道“杨妈！我在这边，您快进来！”杨妈三步并做两步就向东厢房走去，她一进房间就说道“小姐！赶紧把小少爷穿好衣服，赶紧走！”高碧柔一脸疑惑的看向杨妈！杨妈一边帮卓然穿衣服一边说道“待会告诉你，现在赶紧穿衣服！赶紧走！”
高碧柔是了解杨妈的，知道她是一个稳重的人，从来没见过她像今天这样慌张，也就赶紧穿衣服，杨妈现在不敢把高家被灭门的事情告诉高碧柔，她担心高碧柔听到这个消息会受不了，那样就耽误时间了，她现在心里想着的就是赶紧离开这个地方，越快越好，耽误一会危险就增加一分！她亲眼目睹那些杀人魔王的手段的！睡梦中的卓然，突然被人抱起来给他穿衣服，他睁开睡眼朦胧的眼睛看着杨妈说道“杨奶奶！我还想再睡一会！”杨妈说道“然儿听话！杨妈带你去好玩的地方，来把胳膊伸进来！”她嘴上说着话，手里可是一点没闲着，他把卓然的胳膊向小棉袄的袖口里面拽了一拽，紧接着又拿起棉裤，飞快的给卓然穿了起来。此时的高碧柔已经穿好了衣服，杨妈连忙说道“小姐不要闲着，赶紧把东西收拾一下，放到马车上面，要快！”高碧柔能听出杨妈语气很是焦急！她隐隐的有一种不祥的预感！但是她也没多问，连忙去收拾东西！
老蔡这时在外面说道“马车已经套好了！”杨妈连忙说道“老蔡！你快进来把东西放到马车上面。”老蔡闻言走了进来，把已经收拾好东西拿了出去！这时杨妈已经把卓然的衣服穿好了，她抱着卓然就向外面走，她先把卓然放进马车里面，然后她对自己丈夫说道“你在外面看着点！”说完转身就又回到房间里面，她说道“抓紧时间，拣重要的东西拿，赶紧走！”本来高碧柔就没带多少东西，很快就收拾妥当了，高碧柔也上了马车，老蔡问道“杨妈！到底什么事情啊？你这样着急？”杨妈见高碧柔已经到马车上坐好了，这时她才说道“老蔡！待会你赶车，离高家越远越好！昨天晚上一群白衣蒙面人来高家找小姐和小少爷，把高家府里所有人都杀了，我昨天晚上去厕所才躲过一劫，我就让我当家的连夜带着我过来报信，你们赶紧走，他们很快就会找过来了！”高碧柔听完以后大喊一声“爹！娘！”随即人就晕了过去，杨妈又连忙爬上马车，用手指掐高碧柔的人中，高碧柔这才缓缓醒过来，见高碧柔醒过来，杨妈连忙说道“小姐！现在不是悲伤的时候，你和小少爷保命要紧，卓然可是大帅唯一的血脉！你们赶紧走，高家的后事我和当家的去处理！”她说完以后就下了马车，又对老蔡说道“老蔡！走的越远越好！快走！”老蔡点了点头，手里马鞭一抽，马车就向远处走去！杨妈连忙对自己丈夫说道“我们也赶紧走！不要让人知道我们来过这里！”男人连忙驾着牛车离开了这里。
老蔡赶着马车以最快的速度向前狂奔，车里面的高碧柔此时已经哭成了一个泪人，她把卓然紧紧的抱在怀里，小卓然太小，他还不知道发生了什么事情，他伸出自己娇嫩的小手给自己母亲擦拭脸上的泪水，他问道“娘！你怎么哭了？谁欺负娘了？然儿保护娘！”高碧柔听完卓然的话哭的更厉害了，也把卓然搂的更紧了！车外寒风刺骨，老蔡此时呼出来的热气，已经在胡子冻成了冰碴，脸被寒风吹过，就如同针扎一般，但是老蔡一刻也不敢怠慢，两眼紧盯着路面，手中马鞭啪啪的抽在马背上，马儿全力向前奔跑！老蔡这时心里想着的就是远离这个地方，要保住卓然唯一的血脉！
老蔡的儿子和卓正刚一起从军，两人感情一直很好，既是好朋友，又是战友，他们一起并肩作战，在一次战斗中，为了保护卓正刚，老蔡的儿子战死了，临死的时候把自己独居的父亲拜托给夏正刚！此后夏正刚就把老蔡接到自己身边，像自己父亲一样照顾他，什么也不让他做，但是老蔡不愿意过那样的生活，不喜欢吃闲饭，他喜欢做点力所能及的事情，所以他就一直负责赶马车！他对卓家的感情就如同自己的家人也是一样的，他把卓正刚当成儿子一样，卓然当然就是他孙子！现在有人想要自己孙子的命，他肯定要全力去保护好卓然的！老蔡赶着马车一直向前走，他忘记了时间也忘记了饥饿，他的头脑里面只有一个念头，远离这里，越远越好，一刻也不能停留！
马车里面高碧柔的眼泪就没干过，自己的丈夫、爹、娘、弟弟全部都含冤而死了！原本幸福的家庭瞬间没有了！她此刻显得如此的无助，她甚至想了结了自己，去追随她的最爱，去追随她的亲人，可是当她低下头看见自己可爱的儿子！她放弃了此前所有的想法，她下定了决心，一定要把自己的儿子扶养长大，一定要把儿子培养成人，一定要让儿子为自己的亲人报仇，因为她的孩子是卓正刚的儿子！就在她正在恍惚之中，小卓然睡醒了，他看着高碧柔说道“娘！然儿饿了！”高碧柔爱怜的摸了摸男孩的额头说道“然儿！先吃点点心，我们现在急着赶路，等会我们停下来再吃饭好嘛？”高碧柔从一个包裹里面拿出一包点心，本来这些点心是高老爷和高夫人让她带回大帅府的，她打开包装先拿了一点给卓然，然后她站起来把剩下的，递给前面正在赶马车的老蔡，她说道“蔡叔！您先吃点东西，从早上到现在您一口东西都没吃了，身体会抗不住的！”老蔡一边赶着马车一边说道“夫人！我不碍事！暂时没有时间吃，等停下来再说吧！您赶紧到里面去，外面太冷了！”高碧柔看着老蔡的后背无奈的摇了摇头回到了车厢里面。

As she walked inside, Yang's mother shouted, "Miss! Miss! I'm Yang's mother! Which room are you in?" A woman's voice came from the east wing and replied, "Yang's mother! I'm over here, come in quickly!" Yang's mother walked to the east wing in three steps and two steps at a time. As soon as she entered the room, she said, "Miss! Get the young master dressed quickly and leave!" Gao Birou looked at Yang's mother with a puzzled look! Yang's mother said while helping Zhuo Ran get dressed, "I'll tell you later, get dressed now! Hurry and leave!"
Gao Birou knows Yang Ma and knows that she is a stable person. She has never seen her as panicked as she is today, so she quickly puts on her clothes. Yang Ma does not dare to tell Gao Birou about the Gao family being exterminated. She is worried that Gao Birou will not be able to bear the news, which will waste time. What she is thinking about now is to leave this place as soon as possible. The sooner the better, the longer the delay, the more dangerous it will be! She witnessed the methods of those murderous demon kings with her own eyes! Zhuo Ran, who was sleeping, was suddenly picked up and dressed by someone. He opened his sleepy eyes and looked at Yang Ma and said, "Grandma Yang! I want to sleep for a while longer!" Yang Ma said, "Ran'er, be obedient! Yang Ma will take you to a fun place." Fang, come and put your arm in!" She was talking, but her hands were not idle at all. He pulled Zhuo Ran's arm into the cuff of the little cotton-padded jacket, then picked up the cotton pants and quickly put them on for Zhuo Ran. At this time, Gao Birou had already put on her clothes, and Yang Ma said quickly, "Miss, don't be idle. Quickly pack your things and put them on the carriage, quickly!" Gao Birou could hear Yang Ma's anxious tone! She had a vague feeling of ominous premonition! But she didn't ask any questions and hurriedly packed her things!
At this time, Lao Cai said outside, "The carriage has been hitched!" Yang's mother said quickly, "Lao Cai! Come in quickly and put the things on the carriage." Hearing this, Lao Cai came in and took out the packed things! At this time, Yang's mother had already put on Zhuoran's clothes. She hugged Zhuoran and walked outside. She first put Zhuoran into the carriage, and then she said to her husband, "Just watch outside!" After that, she turned around and returned to the room. She said, "Hurry up, pick up important things, and leave quickly!" Originally, Gao Birou didn't bring many things, so she packed them quickly. After that, Gao Birou also got on the carriage. Lao Cai asked, "Mama Yang! What's going on? Are you so anxious?" Ma Yang saw that Gao Birou had already sat on the carriage, and then she said, "Lao Cai! You will drive later, as far away from the Gao family as possible! Last night, a group of masked men in white came to the Gao family to look for the young lady and the young master, and killed everyone in the Gao family's house. I I only escaped by going to the toilet, so I asked my boss to take me over to report the news. You guys should go quickly, they will come here soon!" After hearing this, Gao Birou shouted, "Dad! Mom!" Then she fainted, and Yang Ma quickly climbed onto the carriage and pinched Gao Birou's body with her fingers. Gao Birou slowly woke up. Seeing Gao Birou wake up, Yang Ma quickly She said, "Miss! Now is not the time to be sad. It is important for you and the young master to save their lives. Zhuoran is the only bloodline of the commander! You go quickly, I will handle the funeral affairs of the Gao family with the head of the family!" After she finished speaking, she got off the carriage and said to Lao Cai, "Lao Cai! The further away the better! Let's go!" Lao Cai nodded, whipped the horse whip in his hand, and the carriage walked away! Yang's mother quickly said to her husband, "Let's leave quickly! Don't let anyone know that we have been here!" The man quickly drove the bullock cart and left here.
Lao Cai drove the carriage forward as fast as possible. Gao Birou in the carriage had already burst into tears. She held Zhuoran tightly in her arms. Little Zhuoran was too young and he didn't know what had happened. He stretched out his delicate little hand to wipe the tears from his mother's face. He asked, "Mom! What's wrong with you?"Crying? Who bullied my mother? Ran'er protects mother! "After listening to Zhuo Ran's words, Gao Birou cried harder and hugged Zhuo Ran tighter! The cold wind outside the car was biting, and the hot breath Lao Cai exhaled at this time had frozen into ice on his beard. The cold wind blew over his face, like needles pricking him. But Lao Cai didn't dare to neglect for a moment. He kept his eyes on the road and slapped the riding whip on the horse's back. The horse ran forward with all its strength! What Lao Cai was thinking about at this time was to stay away from this place and save Zhuoran's only bloodline!
Lao Cai's son and Zhuo Zhenggang joined the army together. The two have always had a good relationship. They were both good friends and comrades-in-arms. They fought side by side. In a battle, in order to protect Zhuo Zhenggang, Lao Cai's son died in the battle. When he was dying, he entrusted his father, who lived alone, to Xia Zhenggang! After that, Xia Zhenggang took Lao Cai to his side and took care of him like his father, not letting him do anything. However, Lao Cai didn't want to live that kind of life and didn't like to eat idle food. He liked to do something within his ability, so he was always responsible for driving the carriage! His feelings for the Zhuo family are the same as those of his own family. He treats Zhuo Zhenggang as his son, and Zhuo Ran is of course his grandson! Now that someone wants his grandson's life, he must do his best to protect Zhuoran! Lao Cai drove the carriage forward. He forgot about time and hunger. There was only one thought in his mind, stay away from here, the further away the better, he couldn't stay for a moment!
Gao Birou shed tears in the carriage. Her husband, father, mother, and brother all died of injustice! The originally happy family was gone in an instant! She seemed so helpless at the moment, she even wanted to kill herself, to follow her favorite, to follow her relatives, but when she lowered her head and saw her lovely son! She gave up all her previous thoughts and made up her mind that she must raise her son, train her son to be an adult, and let her son avenge his relatives, because her child is Zhuo Zhenggang's son! Just as she was in a trance, Xiao Zhuoran woke up. He looked at Gao Birou and said, "Mom! Ran'er is hungry! "Gao Birou touched the boy's forehead lovingly and said, "Ran'er! Let’s have some snacks first. We are in a hurry now. How about we stop and eat later? "Gao Birou took out a pack of snacks from a package. Originally, Mr. Gao and Mrs. Gao asked her to take these snacks back to the Marshal's Mansion. She opened the package and took some to Zhuo Ran. Then she stood up and handed the rest to Lao Cai who was driving the carriage in front. She said, "Uncle Cai! Eat something first. You haven't eaten a bite since morning. Your body won't be able to resist it! "Lao Cai said while driving the carriage, "Madam! I'm out of the way! I don’t have time to eat right now, let’s wait until we stop! You hurry inside, it's too cold outside! "Gao Birou looked at Lao Cai's back, shook her head helplessly and returned to the carriage.
